conclusions: Frozen npm 5.3.0 PiP playback succeeds, but destroy(false) retains 3 renderer nodes and 1 Setting in the two-row fixture; this is not candidate cleanup acceptance.
Native PiP bounded 20 rows/s loads pass for candidate on Chromium/Firefox and both cores; WebKit API absence is not native playback evidence.

Actual Mask combined load has five candidate completeness failures and one pre-load delivery failure. Same nominal 20 rows/s on the earlier normal player passes; no root cause or regression relative to published plugin is claimed.
Mask published cases observe delivery loss rather than enforcing candidate completeness; twelve passing cases are not twelve complete-delivery results.
